editorialNarrative.hook: The unbeaten Roosters face the one opponent who can turn their perfect season into unfinished business.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Brisbane are chasing consecutive premierships; Sydney are trying to reverse last year's decider against the same side. Belinda Sharpe takes charge of her fifth grand final, with the premiership settled in one match.
